description: This file defines a static class 'CorrelationIdGenerator' responsible for generating unique correlation IDs using a custom base32 encoding scheme. It maintains an internal counter that is incremented atomically and encodes the counter value into a 13-character string.

classes.name: CorrelationIdGenerator
classes.description: A static class that generates unique correlation IDs based on a timestamp and an internal counter, encoded in a custom base32 format.

methods.name: GetNextId
methods.description: Returns the next unique correlation ID by incrementing the internal counter and generating an ID string.

methods.name: GenerateId
methods.description: Creates a 13-character string ID from a long integer value using a custom base32 encoding.
